name: Castanha
author: Bruno Moniz
description: Bot-free meeting recorder for Omarchy: dual-channel PipeWire capture, a live timer in the bar, and the Bronze, Silver and Gold pipeline for Zinom.

barWidget.description: One icon and one panel: start and stop the recording, the timer, the current or next meeting, a second chance at transcription when the upload failed, and the diagnosis of the last one (silent audio, Zinom error).
